messages.text: Yes, the National Geographic Bartlett 12" Illuminated Blue Ocean Desk Globe is a desktop size — at 12 inches, it sits nicely on a desk, shelf, or credenza rather than the floor. It's also illuminated, so it shows a political map by day and a terrain map lit up at night. Is this one for your own desk, or a gift for someone else's office?
